content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. Spread it over 3–5 meals, with roughly 20–40 g each. Going higher doesn't hurt, but the extra gives you little additional benefit. 💪

Pair it with a small calorie surplus and consistent progressive overload. That combination is what will move your bench toward 100 kg. Tell me your bodyweight if you want me to work out your daily number.
